Definition: Jarib, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jarib is the name of three Israelites, a son of Simeon, a chief man Ezra sent for before the journey to Jerusalem, and a priest who had taken a strange wife. One name covers the tribe, the return, and the failure.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God records the chief man and the failing priest under the same name, and the record is honest about both.
